mapper.insert: INSERT INTO document_edit (edit_id, document_id, content, editing_user_id, editing_start_time, status, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{editId}, #{documentId}, #{content}, #{editingUserId}, #{editingStartTime}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE document_edit SET content = #{content}, editing_user_id = #{editingUserId}, editing_start_time = #{editingStartTime}, status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE document_id = #{documentId}
UPDATE document_edit SET editing_user_id = NULL, editing_start_time = NULL, update_time = NOW() WHERE document_id = #{documentId}
UPDATE document_edit SET content = #{content}, update_time = NOW() WHERE document_id = #{documentId}
